works.title: Rigidity and the lower bound theorem for doubly Cohen-Macaulay complexes
works.read_scope: Full Nevo contribution text; printed960–961 additionally rendered and visually inspected.
works.authored_paraphrase: 2-CM is fixed-field CM with every one-vertex deletion CM of the same dimension. Decomposition into minimal top cycles has facet overlap and reorderability. Sphere choice is posed as a question.
works.prior_full_mapping: Original exact target, not a recorded resolution. A finite Q-2-CM complex with no 2-sphere subcomplex would negate this universal target.

works.title: Rigidity and the Lower Bound Theorem for Doubly Cohen-Macaulay Complexes
works.read_scope: Full v2 text read before candidate. v1 target section and published target/definition/theorem/proof-context compared, plus front matter.
works.exact_locators: v1 Problem3.5; v2 and publication Definition3.1/Theorem3.4/Problem3.7/Lemma3.8; published415–417.
works.authored_paraphrase: The sphere question survives in the published paper; CM intersections are a separate stronger followup. Adding Corollaries3.5–3.6 in v2 shifts question numbering.
works.prior_full_mapping: The target was not already answered in its own journal publication. v2 cover date November2018 is a generated front-date, not its arXiv submission date.

works.title: g-elements, finite buildings and higher Cohen-Macaulay connectivity
works.read_scope: Sections3–4 around convex ears, Theorem4.1 and Problem4.2; full-text searches for Nevo/decompositions/spheres.
works.authored_paraphrase: Convex ear constructions imply 2-CM and some g-vector conclusions; the proof also works for homology-sphere/ball analogues. Problem4.2 asks for Lefschetz conclusions on all 2-CM complexes.
works.prior_full_mapping: One-way sufficient construction and algebraic question. No converse that all 2-CM complexes admit sphere ears, and no negative sphere-cover example in inspected scope.

works.title: Buchsbaum* complexes
works.read_scope: Introduction, Example2.11, Corollary2.12, construction context, Theorem4.1 and proof; all Nevo/decomposition occurrences screened.
works.authored_paraphrase: Minimal-cycle decomposition/rigidity extends to connected Buchsbaum* complexes. The weaker doubly-Buchsbaum examples include an articulation graph, nonorientable manifolds, and torus plus one triangle.
works.prior_full_mapping: Theorem4.1 retains minimal cycles, not spheres. Example2.11(i) is not2-CM, and (iii) retains nonzero H1 so is not CM. These local/weaker-class counterexamples do not resolve the target.

works.title: The Lefschetz property for barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes
works.read_scope: Introduction and Theorem1.1/Corollary1.3 with setup and subdivision proof context.
works.authored_paraphrase: Almost-strong Lefschetz holds for barycentric subdivisions of shellable complexes, yielding g-vector claims for subdivisions of CM complexes.
works.prior_full_mapping: Changes the complex by subdivision and proves algebraic inequalities. Does not assert sphere cover of the original arbitrary2-CM complex.

works.title: Lefschetz Properties and Basic Constructions on Simplicial Spheres
works.read_scope: Abstract/introduction; all CM/decomposition occurrences searched and surrounding scope screened.
works.authored_paraphrase: Studies preservation of strong Lefschetz under joins, connected sums and stellar subdivisions of homology spheres.
works.prior_full_mapping: Sphere-input constructions, not a decomposition assertion on all2-CM complexes. Limited read scope, not a full independent proof audit.

works.title: Rigidity of Balanced Minimal Cycle Complexes
works.read_scope: Introduction; Section3 decomposition setup; Section4 theorem/corollary; Section7 Example7.6; all Nevo occurrences.
works.authored_paraphrase: Generalizes rank-selected rigidity and balanced lower bound inequalities to minimal cycle complexes, using Fogelsanger decompositions. Colored rigidity can fail on specially colored spheres.
works.prior_full_mapping: Different rigidity conclusion and still minimal-cycle pieces. Example7.6 begins with spheres and obstructs sparse rigidity, so is not sphere-cover failure.
works.remaining_access_gap: Published SIAM PDF fetch returned403; latest arXiv entry lists onlyv1. No independent publication-body comparison for this work.

works.title: Multigraded strong Lefschetz property for balanced simplicial complexes
works.read_scope: Published introduction, Section7.2 and Section8.2 with complete relevant statements/proof sketches; correspondingv2 theorem numbering checked.
works.authored_paraphrase: In characteristic2, cycle Gorensteinifications have multigraded SLP and2-CM algebras have top-heavy injections. Certain partial subdivisions of spheres fail WLP under constrained colored parameters.
works.prior_full_mapping: Theorem7.6 uses weighted sums of simplex boundaries after introducing a cone vertex: an algebraic construction, not spheres contained in K. Theorem8.3 is a genuine negative result for colored WLP, not for sphere covers.

works.title: Anisotropy, biased pairings, and the Lefschetz property for pseudomanifolds and cycles
works.authors: Karim Adiprasito, Stavros Papadakis, Vasiliki Petrotou
works.read_scope: Introduction/setup, Section3 and3.1 including proof mechanism; conclusion conjectures.
works.authored_paraphrase: Proves cycle-algebra Lefschetz results, then top-heavy Lefschetz/g-vector results for2-CM by injection into a sum of Gorenstein quotients.
works.prior_full_mapping: Resolves an algebraic motivation of Nevo question without asserting sphere subcomplex decomposition. A Gorenstein quotient associated to a cycle is not an actual homology-sphere subcomplex.

works.title: Complementary vectors of simplicial complexes
works.read_scope: Introduction and Sections2–3; Examples3.2–3.3 and4.9; construction background and paper-wide sphere/decomposition searches; published introduction compared.
works.authored_paraphrase: Classifies complementary vectors of2-CM complexes; some counterexamples concern nongeneric Gorenstein quotients, determinant formulae, and numerical inequalities. Convex ear examples are a subclass.
works.prior_full_mapping: No full prior resolution in inspected scope. The negative graph examples remain cycle-coverable by Nevo Lemma3.2. Algebra quotients/generic cycles do not supply sphere-piece covers.

works.title: Thirty-five years and counting
works.read_scope: Introduction; Section5 full; all Nevo/decomposition occurrences and references screened.
works.exact_locators: Definition5.1; Problem5.2; Theorem5.3; following nonunimodal example and Example5.4; manuscript20–21.
works.authored_paraphrase: Surveys l-CM/g-vector work and records2-CM examples without WLP, including a glued3-sphere/skeleton and a matroid complex.
works.prior_full_mapping: Negative WLP statements are not negative sphere-cover statements. The glued example explicitly contains a sphere; convex ears also cover the cited matroid class. Survey is historical, not current openness evidence.

works.title: The Partition Complex: an invitation to combinatorial commutative algebra
works.read_scope: Introduction, Reisner Theorem27/Remark28, local-star discussion; sphere/subdivision portions; full-text target-word search.
works.authored_paraphrase: Gives partition-of-unity and local-to-global algebra tools; local stars of manifolds are CM; sphere links appear with manifold/disk assumptions.
works.prior_full_mapping: No claim in inspected scope that local CM forces a sphere cover of all2-CM complexes. Remark28 is a relative purity issue, not a target counterexample.

works.title: Combinatorial Lefschetz theorems beyond positivity
works.read_scope: Abstract/introduction; all three CM occurrences and decomposition contexts screened; Section3.6 read.
works.authored_paraphrase: CM partition of unity and sphere Poincare duality are algebraic tools.
works.prior_full_mapping: No explicit2-CM sphere-cover resolution in bounded inspected scope; not a full77-page technical verification.

works.title: Repeated Lefschetz-like decompositions for flag doubly Cohen-Macaulay simplicial complexes and gamma vectors of flag spheres
